public_rationale: No decisive early event was found. Hut 8's schedule and local reporting contemplate delivery or operation during 2027, which would challenge the adopted two-year reading. Those are plans, not completed service. Construction continuing in October 2026 does not establish that the facility will remain unavailable for years.
limitations: The two-year boundary and operational meaning of 'exist' are evaluator interpretations.
The campus identification relies on reporting rather than a publicly inspected contract.
Initial data-hall handover may precede customer compute delivery.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The data center under the Anthropic-Lambda deal will not exist for years, if ever.

statement.excerpt: Neither of these companies can actually afford this compute, but that doesn’t matter, because this data center won’t actually exist for years, if it ever does.

our_interpretation: Assess the normalized facility forecast, not the separate assertion about affordability.
Read 'exist' as beginning to deliver the contracted compute service, rather than merely having a building or construction site.
Use two years as the minimum ordinary meaning of 'for years'. The September 2028 boundary tests that minimum duration; the speaker supplied no exact completion deadline.
'If it ever does' expresses doubt, not a categorical prediction of permanent cancellation.
The facility's identity must be established independently from reporting about the Anthropic–Lambda agreement.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable records establish that the identified facility did not begin delivering the contracted compute service before the two-year anniversary of publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable commissioning and customer-service records establish delivery of the contracted compute service before the two-year anniversary.
